sn23.3:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn23.3:1.4: katamā nu kho bhante bhavanetti katamo bhavanettinirodhoti.
sn23.3:1.5: rūpe kho rādha yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā.
sn23.3:1.11: viññāṇe yo chando yo rāgo yā nandi yā taṇhā ye upāyupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā.
